description: This file defines classes related to performance metrics tracing within a plugin framework. It includes classes for logging plugin activation, deactivation, memory usage, and browser events, with internal interfaces and utilities to manage metrics logging behavior.

classes.name: Metric
classes.description: A class for managing formatted metric text, supporting construction from printf-style format strings and std::string objects.

classes.name: MetricsTraceOuput
classes.description: Implements the IStateMetricsLogger interface to log plugin state metrics like activation, suspension, and memory usage.

classes.name: MetricsTraceOuputBrowser
classes.description: Implements the IBrowserMetricsLogger interface to log browser-specific metrics like page load, suspension, and URL changes.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables metrics logging for a plugin or browser, associating a callsign and querying for memory interface.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables metrics logging, releasing the memory interface if active.

methods.name: Activated
methods.description: Logs when a plugin is activated, including resident set size memory info.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Logs when a plugin is deactivated, including uptime.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Logs when a plugin resumes, including memory info.

methods.name: Suspended
methods.description: Logs when a plugin is suspended, including memory info.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Logs the completion of a page load, including success status, total successes and failures, and memory info.

methods.name: URLChange
methods.description: Placeholder for URL change events (empty implementation).

methods.name: VisibilityChange
methods.description: Placeholder for visibility change events (empty implementation).
